summary.text: Jen Lunsford is the incumbent Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 135 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney who practiced personal injury, workers' compensation and Social Security disability law for eleven years before taking office, she represents parts of eastern Monroe County.

paragraphs.text: Lunsford is originally from Long Island and graduated from Patchogue-Medford High School in 2000.
She completed a bachelor's degree in political science and philosophy at Hartwick College in 2004 and graduated from Boston University School of Law, and she has lived in Monroe County since 2009.
She volunteered with organizations including Lawyers for Good Government and If/When/How.
Lunsford represents the 135th Assembly District, which includes the towns of Penfield, East Rochester, Perinton, Pittsford and Mendon.
She is a member of the Children and Families, Environmental Conservation, Health, Insurance, Judiciary, and Libraries and Education Technology committees.
Her official biography says she lives in Perinton with her husband and son.
